== Foldable devices in manual sessions

- The live screen view and screenshots now follow the active screen when an Android foldable device changes posture during a manual session. Touch input and rotation stay aligned with the screen in each posture.
- Screenshots keep the aspect ratio of the screen that is active when the screenshot is taken, and are never enlarged beyond the device's native resolution.
- Screenshots stay correct after you close and reopen the *Screenshots* panel during a session.
- *Lightning Mode* keeps a stable stream across repeated rotation on phones and tablets.

[NOTE]
====
Foldable behavior is confirmed on the Galaxy Z Fold3 5G. On the Galaxy Z Flip3 5G, the screen view does not resize when the device is closed, and the video can stay black after the device is opened again until you turn *Lightning Mode* off. Kobiton tracks both behaviors separately.
====
